runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: orthographic albedo texture source for an existing 3D game prop.
Create exactly ONE 1024 x 1024 RGBA image with a truly transparent background. Edit image 1, guide_back.png, by painting materials onto its existing grey surfaces.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 guide_back.png is the EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for back-view camera, projection, every geometric edge, silhouette, scale and position.
Image 2 design_reference.png is the approved colour, material and design reference ONLY.
Image 3 concept_crop.png is the original concept reference ONLY.
Keep image 1's exact 1024 x 1024 canvas and exact alpha silhouette: the object occupies roughly x=66..957 and y=319..705. Preserve all the large transparent margins. Do not enlarge, shrink, rotate, recenter, straighten, reframe or crop. Preserve every contour kink, side strap, buckle opening, overlap and shape edge at its exact guide location. This is a paint-over, not a redesign. The back view must remain the back view; do not use the references' front three-quarter composition or reveal a new bag opening.
SUBJECT: the opened Colony satchel seen FROM THE BACK, in precisely the guide's pose. Apply worn faded deep-blue canvas and sand canvas, fine stitching and dusty scuffs from the approved design; pale sand canvas for lining where visible; tan leather on the guide's existing straps; aged matte brass on the existing buckles. The sand flap has the reference's red cloth band with thin gold embroidered edging and the simple gold ring-with-short-stem sigil, where that flap is visible from this back angle. Keep all straps and panel boundaries aligned to the guide geometry; do not invent extra straps, pockets, folds that change geometry, or hardware. Match the approved worn handmade canvas/leather material identity and colour palette, with readable weave, stitches and wear.
LIGHTING: strictly an unlit ALBEDO material painting, even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. Remove the grey guide's illumination gradients. Use base surface colour, fine material grain, stitching and wear to show materials, not shaded volumes. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or dark crease shading, no dark underside lighting, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Brass is muted brass-colour albedo, not gleaming polished metal. No baked lighting, background, floor, vignette, glow, halo, text, labels or watermark.
Return the image at native 1024 x 1024 without resizing. Change only the surface colours/material appearance inside the exact guide alpha, preserving the silhouette pixel for pixel and all internal geometry.
runs.reason: Best available unmodified return: 99.01% silhouette overlap in normalised canvas coordinates, versus 81.88% for the corrective return. Selected for closest guide alignment, but it does not fully satisfy the brief.
